answers.core: In my PR I had to make changes to core classes. I don't know if the same result is achievable without those kinds of changes.
answers.workaround:
I suppose it will be used often, since the desire to reduce the default blue tint is common sense at least to newcomers. The questions "why is everything blue?" and "how I reduce the blue tint?" seem to be common with newcomers.

I have tried to work around it using only a spatial but without success (I'm not saying it's impossible, I'm saying I wasn't able to make it work).

title: Allow desaturating the sky contribution to ambient lighting
